newsitem.title: USA: Coastal to revamp U.S. eastern operations.
newsitem.headline: Coastal to revamp U.S. eastern operations.

text.p: Coastal Corp said Wednesday it will restructure its refined products marketing and supply operations in the eastern United States.

The company said it will cut about 110 positions as part of the restructuring. It said it would try to transfer those who lose their jobs to other parts of the company and offer severance packages to those it cannot transfer.
The company said the restructuring was part of its plan to focus on businesses supported by its refineries and terminals operated by it.
"We expect this restructuring to maintain our presence and increase our profitability in the eastern United States, while reducing inventories and operating costs," it said.
Coastal, an oil and gas company, operates refineries in New Jersey, Texas, and Aruba, with a total refining capacity of 435,000 barrels per day.

The company said the restructuring will emphasize products produced at these refineries and distributed through the company's own terminals in the northeast and Florida. Regular operations will cease from third-party terminals, it added.
Coastal did not say if it expected to take any charges as a result of the restructuring and company officials were unavailable for comment.
